header.name: Netherite No Despawn
header.description: v1.0.0 - Dropped netherite tools, weapons and armour never despawn, and optionally neither do items you have renamed.

settings.text: §l§aNetherite No Despawn§r - dropped items that would normally vanish after five minutes stay where they fell.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r
§7Swords, spears, pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, the four armour pieces, and netherite horse and nautilus armour. Ingots, scrap, blocks and upgrade templates are not covered.§r
§7Any item given a name at an anvil, whatever it is made of. Off by default: a renamed stack of dirt would never go away either.§r
